commands.summary: Read a project file: its designs, board, central library and library lists.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

commands.summary: List the parts of the project's central library.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --limit
flags.summary: Items per page; default 20, at most 100.

flags.name: --offset
flags.summary: Start position of the page; default 0.

commands.summary: Read one part: its pin map, symbols, footprint cell, padstacks and the problems found.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --id
flags.summary: The part number.

commands.summary: Add parts to the central library from a parts file: symbol, IPC-7351B footprint, padstacks and pin map; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --file
flags.summary: The parts file (JSON). A part identical to the library's is skipped; a part number the library holds with other content is refused.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: List the padstacks of the project's central library, with their type, pad and hole sizes.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --type
flags.summary: Only padstacks of this type: via, smd, through or mounting_hole.

flags.name: --limit
flags.summary: Items per page; default 20, at most 100.

flags.name: --offset
flags.summary: Start position of the page; default 0.

commands.summary: Add a via padstack to the central library: a plated hole, a round pad on every conductor layer, and a soldermask opening or none (tented); runs as a long job.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --drill
flags.summary: The finished hole diameter.

flags.name: --pad
flags.summary: The pad diameter on every conductor layer; wider than the hole.

flags.name: --mask
flags.summary: The soldermask opening's diameter; without it the via is tented, covered by soldermask or coverlay.

flags.name: --name
flags.summary: The padstack's name; VIA_D<drill>_P<pad> in mm by default, such as VIA_D0.2_P0.4.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Package the schematic for Layout with Xpedition's packager and report its errors and warnings; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Read the open schematic: its sheets and the numbers of components and nets.

flags.name: --session

flags.name: --doc

commands.summary: Draw the whole schematic from a design file, replacing every sheet it names; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --doc

flags.name: --design

flags.name: --output

commands.summary: Run Designer's verification and this tool's netlist rules, and list the problems found; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --doc

flags.name: --output

commands.summary: Create the project's board from a layout template with Xpedition's JobWizard; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --template
flags.summary: The layout template's name; 4 Layer Template by default.

flags.name: --name
flags.summary: The board's name: letters, digits, - and _; the project's name by default.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Bring the packaged schematic into the open board; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Replace the board outline by a rectangle from the origin; the route border and manufacturing outline follow.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --width
flags.summary: The board's width.

flags.name: --height
flags.summary: The board's height.

flags.name: --radius
flags.summary: The corner radius, 0 for square corners; the board's current radius by default.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Place every component of the board from its connections, grouped by schematic sheet; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --design
flags.summary: The design file the schematic was drawn from; its sheets and zones group the parts.

flags.name: --all
flags.summary: Place the parts already placed again too.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Pour a plane shape for one net on one layer, inside the board outline: solid, or hatched.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --net
flags.summary: The net, such as GND.

flags.name: --layer
flags.summary: The conductor layer number, 1 at the top.

flags.name: --margin
flags.summary: The distance from the board outline; 1 mm by default.

flags.name: --hatch
flags.summary: solid (the default), orthogonal or diagonal: a hatched plane, common on flex, is a grid of lines.

flags.name: --hatch-width
flags.summary: A hatched plane's line width.

flags.name: --hatch-distance
flags.summary: A hatched plane's distance from line to line, larger than the width.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Route the open nets with Layout's autorouter passes: every net, or only the nets and net classes named; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --layers
flags.summary: The conductor layers to route on, such as 1,4; all by default.

flags.name: --nets
flags.summary: Route only these nets, such as SS_TX1_P,SS_TX1_N.

flags.name: --net-classes
flags.summary: Route only the nets of these net classes, such as USB_SS.

flags.name: --passes
flags.summary: The autorouter passes in order, each with its effort 1 to 5, such as fanout:1,route:1-5,smooth; route:1-5,viamin:1-3,smooth:1-3 by default. Passes: fanout, route, novia, viamin, smooth, spread, expand, removehangers.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Read the open board: counts, layer stack, net classes with their widths and vias, geometry and layout metrics.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the whole result to this JSON file; the response keeps the summary.

commands.summary: Write the fabrication package: ODB++, Gerber, NC drill, a centroid file, a BOM and a manifest; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --session

flags.name: --doc

flags.name: --output

commands.summary: Draw the traces and place the vias of a routing plan, after checking it against the board's copper, the net classes' widths and the clearance rules; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --file
flags.summary: The routing plan (JSON): traces with net, layer, width_mm and points_mm, and vias with net, at_mm and padstack, in board coordinates.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Delete the traces of the nets named, on every layer or on the layers named; their vias stay.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --nets
flags.summary: The nets whose traces go, such as SS_TX1_P,SS_TX1_N.

flags.name: --layers
flags.summary: Only on these conductor layers, such as 1,4; every layer by default.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Delete the vias of the nets named: routing vias and stitching vias alike.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --nets
flags.summary: The nets whose vias go, such as GND.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Delete the plane shapes of one net on one layer, and with them its copper there.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --net
flags.summary: The net, such as GND.

flags.name: --layer
flags.summary: The conductor layer number, 1 at the top.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Place vias of one net: one at --x, --y, or a stitching grid at --pitch inside the net's copper on two layers, clear of other copper by the default clearance rule; runs as a long job.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --net
flags.summary: The net, such as GND.

flags.name: --x
flags.summary: One via's X position.
flags.coordinate_system: Board coordinates in mm: the origin is the board origin, the lower left corner of the outline pcb update draws; x to the right, y up, seen from the top side.

flags.name: --y
flags.summary: One via's Y position.
flags.coordinate_system: Board coordinates in mm: the origin is the board origin, the lower left corner of the outline pcb update draws; x to the right, y up, seen from the top side.

flags.name: --pitch
flags.summary: The stitching grid's pitch, such as 2mm.

flags.name: --margin
flags.summary: The grid's distance from the board outline; 0.5 mm by default.

flags.name: --padstack
flags.summary: The via padstack; the via the net's class is assigned by default (pcb get lists it).

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Change the vias of the nets named, or of the nets of the net classes named, to another via padstack, pulled from the central library when the board lacks it.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --nets
flags.summary: The nets whose vias change, such as SS_TX1_P,SS_TX1_N.

flags.name: --net-classes
flags.summary: The net classes whose nets' vias change, such as USB_SS.

flags.name: --padstack
flags.summary: The via padstack, such as VIA_D0.2_P0.4; padstack list --type via lists the central library's.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Open the soldermask, or the coverlay of a flex board, over a rectangle on one side, so the copper under it is bare.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --x1
flags.summary: One corner's X.
flags.coordinate_system: Board coordinates in mm: the origin is the board origin, the lower left corner of the outline pcb update draws; x to the right, y up, seen from the top side.

flags.name: --y1
flags.summary: One corner's Y.
flags.coordinate_system: Board coordinates in mm: the origin is the board origin, the lower left corner of the outline pcb update draws; x to the right, y up, seen from the top side.

flags.name: --x2
flags.summary: The opposite corner's X.
flags.coordinate_system: Board coordinates in mm: the origin is the board origin, the lower left corner of the outline pcb update draws; x to the right, y up, seen from the top side.

flags.name: --y2
flags.summary: The opposite corner's Y.
flags.coordinate_system: Board coordinates in mm: the origin is the board origin, the lower left corner of the outline pcb update draws; x to the right, y up, seen from the top side.

flags.name: --side
flags.summary: top (the default) or bottom.

flags.name: --cover-layer
flags.summary: Open the coverlay of a flex board instead of the soldermask.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Delete the soldermask or coverlay opening that contains a point on one side.

flags.name: --session

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --x
flags.summary: A point inside the opening: its X.
flags.coordinate_system: Board coordinates in mm: the origin is the board origin, the lower left corner of the outline pcb update draws; x to the right, y up, seen from the top side.

flags.name: --y
flags.summary: Its Y.
flags.coordinate_system: Board coordinates in mm: the origin is the board origin, the lower left corner of the outline pcb update draws; x to the right, y up, seen from the top side.

flags.name: --side
flags.summary: top (the default) or bottom.

flags.name: --cover-layer
flags.summary: The opening is in the coverlay, not the soldermask.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Draw the board as a PNG from its geometry: outline, pads, traces, vias, plane shapes, holes and soldermask openings, seen from the top or the bottom.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: The .png file to write.

flags.name: --side
flags.summary: top (the default) or bottom, which is drawn mirrored left to right.

flags.name: --layers
flags.summary: The conductor layers to draw, such as 1,2; every layer by default.

flags.name: --resolution
flags.summary: Pixels per mm, 1 to 200; 20 by default, lowered to keep the picture within 4000 pixels.

commands.summary: Read the board's constraints: net classes and their nets, trace widths and differential spacing per layer, differential pairs, clearance rules and which class pairs use them.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write every rule to this file, in the rules file format constraint import reads; the response keeps the summary.

commands.summary: Create or change the net classes, trace widths, differential spacing, differential pairs and clearance rules a rules file names, then load them into Layout; rules the file does not name stay as they are.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --file
flags.summary: The rules file (JSON), in the format constraint get writes; it names only what to create or change.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.
